{{Quote|There's one for a Captain Terrae Lekes. Small time ship thief, out in the Minos Cluster.|[[Opdoa]], examining the bounty on Terrae Lekes|<ref name="New Assignments">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide|story=New Assignments}}</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Terrae Lekes''' was a small-time [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] operating in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Lekes, which was processed through the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters']] guild. The [[Guild Assignments Group]], considering the capture of Lekes to be an easy task, assigned the bounty to [[Teksli Yenak]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]] from the Rodian [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] with a less-than-impressive reputation.
